note.en: The Chamber never opens again: the party starves inside
note.es: La cámara no se vuelve a abrir: el grupo muere de hambre dentro

note.en: Every exit is jammed and needs a check to open it (Hard DC)
note.es: Cada salida está atascada y pide una prueba para abrirla (Dificultad Difícil)

note.en: Doubles the Timer's rounds
note.es: Dobla las rondas del Temporizador

note.en: Magic runs wild: every spell, magical ability or activated item rolls an effect
note.es: La magia se desboca: cada conjuro, habilidad mágica u objeto activado tira un efecto

of.en: Table 3.1, wild magic effect, every time magic is used
of.es: Tabla 3.1, efecto de magia salvaje, cada vez que se usa magia

check.en: Check with the Sistema de Incursión: there, magic is rune shaping (Moldeo), so what triggers a Table 3.1 effect has to be matched
check.es: Verificar con el Sistema de Incursión: allí la magia es moldear runas, así que hay que cuadrar qué dispara un efecto de la Tabla 3.1

note.en: The Inhabitants are infected and pass it on to whoever they hit, unless they make a save
note.es: Los habitantes están infectados y contagian a quien golpeen, salvo con una prueba de salvación

check.en: Check with the Sistema de Incursión: which of its four saves applies, and which rune school breaks the infection
check.es: Verificar con el Sistema de Incursión: cuál de sus cuatro salvaciones aplica, y qué escuela de runas rompe la infección

note.en: A mist raises whoever dies inside as a Zombie, and some are already attacking
note.es: Una niebla levanta como Zombie a quien muere dentro, y ya hay algunos atacando

of.en: rounds until a dead body rises
of.es: rondas hasta que un muerto se levanta

note.en: A field turns whoever steps in into a beast of the Maze, body and mind; each part is avoided with its own save
note.es: Un campo convierte en bestia del Laberinto a quien lo pisa, en cuerpo y mente; cada parte se evita con su prueba de salvación

check.en: Check with the Sistema de Incursión: the book's Stamina and Spiritual saves against its own saves (Aguante, Voluntad…)
check.es: Verificar con el Sistema de Incursión: las salvaciones Stamina y Spiritual del libro frente a las suyas (Aguante, Voluntad…)

note.en: A mist blocks sight; its kind comes from its own table, and there is always a safe route
note.es: Una niebla impide la vista; su tipo sale de su propia tabla, y siempre hay una ruta segura

note.en: Double Monster: roll Inhabitants twice, or double the result
note.es: Doble monstruo: se tiran dos veces los Habitantes, o se dobla el resultado

note.en: A pack of Ghouls is raiding the Chamber; their Black Spot brings them back in later Raids
note.es: Una manada de Ghouls saquea la cámara; su Black Spot los trae de vuelta en otras incursiones

note.en: No condition: the Chamber is as its entry describes it
note.es: Sin condición: la cámara es la que describe su entrada

note.en: A group of Raiders in distress is fighting the Inhabitants: helping them brings recruits or contact with another Bonfire
note.es: Un grupo de Incursores en apuros pelea con los habitantes: ayudarlos da reclutas o contacto con otra Hoguera

note.en: An infected Myconid alerts the whole Chamber; if it doesn't die in time, it draws another Inhabitant
note.es: Un Myconid infectado alerta a toda la cámara; si no muere a tiempo, atrae otro habitante

of.en: rounds before it draws another Inhabitant
of.es: rondas antes de que atraiga otro habitante

note.en: A Legendary Raider appears, who may help, threaten or join the party
note.es: Aparece un Legendary Raider, que puede ayudar, amenazar o unirse al grupo

note.en: A Myconid market: you can trade, and if there are many, Raiders from another Bonfire are visiting
note.es: Un mercado de Myconids: se puede comerciar, y si son muchos hay visitas de otra Hoguera

of.en: one roll on Table C and one on Table 4.1 per Myconid: what they sell
of.es: una tirada en la Tabla C y otra en la 4.1 por Myconid: lo que venden

of.en: Raiders from another Bonfire, if there are more than 10 Myconids
of.es: Incursores de otra Hoguera, si hay más de 10 Myconids

note.en: There is a Circle: it lets them escape to a random or a marked Chamber
note.es: Hay un Círculo: sirve para huir a una cámara al azar o a una marcada

note.en: Runes cancel one school of magic: no spells, abilities or items of that school
note.es: Unas runas anulan una escuela de magia: no hay conjuros, habilidades ni objetos de esa escuela

check.en: Check with the Sistema de Incursión: Table 3.4 names the book's schools, and the Sistema has its own rune schools (p. IV)
check.es: Verificar con el Sistema de Incursión: la Tabla 3.4 nombra las escuelas del libro, y el Sistema tiene sus propias escuelas de runas (p. IV)

note.en: It rains inside: they can fill every container they carry with water
note.es: Llueve dentro: se puede llenar de agua todo lo que se cargue

note.en: Half the Timer's rounds, rounded down
note.es: Mitad de rondas del Temporizador, redondeando hacia abajo

note.en: They can leave whenever they want through an entry; no countdown, but they still have to find it
note.es: Se puede salir cuando se quiera por una entrada; no hay cuenta atrás, pero hay que encontrarla

note.en: Check Point Chamber: it's marked on the map for good and they can come back
note.es: Cámara de control: se marca en el mapa para siempre y se puede volver

note.en: A signal is sent throughout the Chambers until it reaches the closest Decan House. During the next Raid, one of the Twelve Punishments will appear in the Chamber and fight the Raiders in any Chamber they visit. Roll once on the Decan House Encounter table 3.7.
note.es: Una señal recorre las cámaras hasta la Decan House más cercana: en la próxima incursión uno de los Doce Castigos aparece en la cámara y pelea con los Incursores en cualquier cámara que visiten; se tira una vez en la tabla 3.7 (Decan House Encounter, p. 114)

note.en: The School Forbiddance condition activates twice. Roll twice on the School Forbiddance table 3.4 and apply them.
note.es: La condición School Forbiddance se activa dos veces: se tira dos veces en la tabla 3.4 (School Forbiddance, p. 94) y se aplican las dos

note.en: The spell or magical effect rebounds on the caster with twice the effect (double damage, area of effect, and duration). The caster is not entitled to a saving throw. If the effect cannot rebound, it fails.
note.es: El conjuro o efecto mágico rebota con el doble de efecto (daño, área y duración) sobre quien lo lanzó, que no tiene prueba de salvación; si el efecto no puede rebotar, falla

note.en: The spell rebounds on the caster with normal effect. If it cannot rebound, it fails. Saving throw allowed.
note.es: El conjuro rebota en quien lo lanzó con efecto normal, y con prueba de salvación; si no puede rebotar, falla

note.en: The spell does not work and transforms into negative or necrotic energy. Everyone (friend or foe) within a medium-range to the caster receives 1d8 of necrotic damage per caster level of the original source. Stamina halves (Average DC).
note.es: El conjuro falla y se vuelve energía negativa o necrótica: todos los que estén a distancia media de quien lo lanzó, amigos o no, reciben 1d8 de daño necrótico por nivel de lanzador de la fuente original; Stamina lo reduce a la mitad (Dificultad Media)

note.en: The spell does not function. Everything used to cast it is consumed. An item loses charges.
note.es: El conjuro no funciona y se consume todo lo que se usó para lanzarlo; si fue un objeto, pierde cargas

note.en: The spell functions normally.
note.es: El conjuro funciona con normalidad

note.en: Table 3.1 has no result for 51-59 or 81-87 (p. 88): the book skips them, so the Maze Master decides
note.es: La Tabla 3.1 no trae resultado para el 51-59 ni el 81-87 (p. 88): el libro se los salta, así que decide el Amo del Laberinto

note.en: The spell does not function. Everything used to cast it is not consumed. An item does not use charges.
note.es: El conjuro no funciona, pero no se consume nada de lo que se usó para lanzarlo; si fue un objeto, no gasta cargas

note.en: The spell does not work and transforms into positive or radiant energy. Everyone (friend or foe) within a medium-range to the caster heals 1d8 of damage per caster level of the original source. Stamina halves (Average DC). It counts as radiant damage for the undead.
note.es: El conjuro falla y se vuelve energía positiva o radiante: todos los que estén a distancia media de quien lo lanzó, amigos o no, curan 1d8 de daño por nivel de lanzador de la fuente original; Stamina lo reduce a la mitad (Dificultad Media), y en los no muertos cuenta como daño radiante

note.en: The spell affects a random target or area.
note.es: El conjuro afecta a un objetivo o a un área al azar

note.en: Table 3.1 has no result for 51-59 or 81-87 (p. 88): the book skips them, so the Maze Master decides
note.es: La Tabla 3.1 no trae resultado para el 51-59 ni el 81-87 (p. 88): el libro se los salta, así que decide el Amo del Laberinto

note.en: The spell functions with twice the effect (double damage, area of effect, and duration). If it cannot, it fails.
note.es: El conjuro funciona con el doble de efecto (daño, área y duración); si no puede, falla

note.es: El conjuro funciona con normalidad, pero es tan potente que los objetivos no tienen prueba de salvación

note.en: A signal is sent through the Chambers until it reaches the closest Zephyr. During the next Raid, one of the Ten Zephyr will appear in the Chamber and attend a Raiders' request. Roll once on the Zephyr Encounter table 5.5.
note.es: Una señal recorre las cámaras hasta el Zephyr más cercano: en la próxima incursión uno de los diez aparece en la cámara y atiende una petición de los Incursores; se tira una vez en la tabla 5.5 (Zephyr Encounter, p. 415)
La niebla bloquea la visibilidad incluso con visiones especiales, amortigua el sonido y dificulta orientarse o detectar amenazas. La Máscara de Oktar permite ignorar su impedimento visual.
Tras tres rondas, las chispas afectan a los seres vivos. Conserva las dificultades de visibilidad de Greymist. Consulta la variante de energía.
La niebla forma un muro sólido; su clave elemental puede dispersarlo durante una hora. Un resultado 6 requiere una decisión del Amo.
La niebla se espesa o forma corrientes que desplazan a los viajeros; el Amo resuelve el recorrido y las salvaciones.

rows.label: Maze Master's choice · elección del Amo

note.en: A human mage with obsidian black hair and bright blue eyes that glow in the darkness. She is a Veteran Raider that was the Librarian of a Bonfire in the past. Those days are now long gone. She wanders The Maze looking for any knowledge on the origins of the Black King. She can be found in a chamber that has enclosed secrets and clues about the Black Pieces, and is actively seeking the Infinite Library. She is helpful toward any Raider group, but she is not an ally. Hence, she won't hesitate to betray anyone that goes with her on his quest for knowledge. Additionally, she carries some magical cursed objects including an obsidian stone that can negate all damage once.
note.es: Maga humana de cabello negro y ojos azules luminosos; antigua Bibliotecaria. Busca información sobre el Rey Negro y la Biblioteca Infinita. Puede ayudar, pero prioriza su búsqueda. El Amo decide su participación en el encuentro.

note.en: She is a lizardfolk warrior with lustrous black scales, obsidian eyes, and a slim, tall figure. She is a versatile and marvelous fighter, who once be- longed to Old Don's Bonfire. For a long time, she helped to find resources for the Bonfire and the components of the Ultimate Weapon. Then, she visited the Infinite Library and decided to abandon Old Don's Bonfire to record information about the Maze in the company of a walking sapient metal book that writes everything by itself.
note.es: Guerrera reptiliana de escamas negras. Dejó la Hoguera de Old Don para registrar información del Laberinto junto a un libro ambulante de Metal Sapiente. El Amo decide su participación en el encuentro.

note.en: Braids is a human barbarian, bald and with a long red-haired beard that he wears in a long braid, so he can forge items without burning it. He has blue eyes and has a large build for a human, almost as large as an ogre. He does not trust others easily, but grants his confidence to those that support their words in actions. He is a blacksmith, whose skin has blackened due to the intense fire he uses and the lack of a bath.
note.es: Herrero humano corpulento, calvo y de larga barba roja trenzada. Desconfía de las promesas y respeta a quienes respaldan sus palabras con acciones. El Amo decide su participación en el encuentro.

note.en: Epick is a human with medium height and very thin complexion. He has caucasian features, light brown hair, and wears humble bartender clothes. He has a pair of warm and joyful blue eyes and is known because he carries everywhere a necklace made of fresh garlic. Even though he lives with fear because of the monsters in the Maze, he has full confidence in the Raiders and their intentions.
note.es: Humano delgado de aspecto humilde, ojos azules alegres y un collar de ajo fresco. Teme a los monstruos, pero confía en los Raiders. El Amo decide su participación en el encuentro.

note.en: A Half-giant fighter with short, dark hair and a friendly face that is in- congruous with his fearsome silhouette clad in patchwork armor of scav- enged leather and metal, wielding what looks like a tree branch with a big, black rock tied to it. He is an experienced Raider that joined up with Old Don's Bonfire upon arriving in the Maze. He can be found in any chamber tied to the Builders, where Builder activity has been detected, or where an entrance has jammed, smashing his weapon against it to force it open. Good-natured, he will happily help out fellow friendly Raiders if they cross his path, but often leaves as soon as the group diverges from his search for the Builders and their tools. He also tends to stick his foot in his mouth by revealing opinions or bits of information that he ought not to, a trait that causes some friction with Old Don and the Council of the Three whenever he visits the Bonfire.
note.es: Guerrero semigigante amistoso, con armadura de retazos. Busca a los Constructores y sus herramientas; ayuda a otros Raiders mientras coincidan con su recorrido. El Amo decide su participación en el encuentro.

note.en: Jim Foulweather is a mazeborn halfling in his mid-thirties, with messy, brown hair and an untended, short beard. He wears a battered span- genhelm-style helmet, with worn-out studded leather armor, thick linen trousers, and explorer's boots. If you pay attention, behind his messy hair and tucked inside his armor, you could see a thin iron chain wrapped around his neck. Jim had a Bonfire a long time ago, but he was kicked out for reasons unknown to most people (and the Raiders). He now wanders The Maze, trying to find a Raid Pack that would take him back to their Bonfire. He is extremely nimble and dexterous, despite his beer belly, and can throw almost anything with incredible precision. He is known to steal resources and food from Red and Black Outposts, and then use the bounty to try to get another Raiders' favor. The few times he has been caught on these outposts, he managed to escape by incredibly fortuitous coincidences, earning him the "Lucky Charm" title.
note.es: Mediano nacido en el Laberinto, expulsado de una Hoguera. Busca un grupo que lo acoja y suele robar recursos de los puestos rojos y negros. El Amo decide su participación en el encuentro.

note.en: He is a middle-aged human with long, dark hair that covers his face almost entirely, only allowing his broad, terrifying smile to be seen. Countless battles in the Maze have covered his brown skin with scars. He does not wear anything but a pair of snugged and worn-out black leather trousers. On his shoulders and knees, he brazenly wears as an ornament the masks and helmets of the Hitmen and Mazeknights he has executed. He employs pieces of their armors as bracelets and greaves, which he has covered with spikes.
note.es: Humano de largo cabello oscuro, sonrisa inquietante y muchas cicatrices. Lleva máscaras y piezas de armadura de los Hitmen y Mazeknights que ha ejecutado. El Amo decide su participación en el encuentro.

note.en: She is a medium size Tortle with blue eyes (she is not blind). Like most of the Raiders, she has scars across arms and legs, but the most distinguished one is on her shell. It runs through the length of her shell and cuts deep, but it does not hit the flesh underneath. Most Raiders know that, when they go out with Pawndissolver, they should always keep her within sight as she is known to throw explosives or acids at any given moment. She carries a bag with a portable lab.
note.es: Tortle de ojos azules y gran cicatriz en el caparazón. Lleva un laboratorio portátil y es conocida por recurrir a ácidos y explosivos. El Amo decide su participación en el encuentro.

note.en: Petra is a beautiful woman in her late twenties. She is of medium height and has a skinny complexion. Her body shows signs of famine and weari- ness, but it is also well-trained as a result of her continuous travels around the Maze. She has long, red hair, pale skin, and grey eyes; she is not too worried about her appearance, however. That is why her hair is scruffy and has random dreadlocks. She avoids taking baths regularly, so her skin is caked with dirt and blood, something she claims is necessary to protect herself from the dangers in the Maze. She wears studded, leather armor and often carries both fresh and spoiled meat from creatures killed by her party of Raiders. Petra is a defiant, annoying, and sarcastic person who seems too bored and careless all the time. Nevertheless, Petra has a very good perception, and her reflexes have saved her and her companions countless times. She is always chewing and eating, alleging she needs ev- ery nutrient she can get.
note.es: Viajera humana pelirroja, de ojos grises y aspecto descuidado. Sarcástica y desafiante, se mantiene alerta y suele llevar carne recogida durante las incursiones. El Amo decide su participación en el encuentro.

note.en: Pike Jumper is a human warrior with long brown hair, tanned skin, and a long tattoo on his left shoulder. He is recognized for carrying two un- matched heavy swords meant for the Red Queen and the Black King. He wanders the Maze surviving on the spoils resulting from the clash between the Red and Black Pieces. Pike Jumper is an avid fighter of both the Red Queen's and the Black King's guilds. He wants to escape the Maze and is convinced the only way to achieve that end is to forge an alliance between all the standing Bonfires. He appears every once in a while near the Bon- fires to trade goods and share information, and would gladly step forward to fight alongside the Raiders, mostly against the Pieces.
note.es: Guerrero humano que porta dos grandes espadas. Combate a ambas facciones y cree que una alianza entre las Hogueras permitirá escapar. El Amo decide su participación en el encuentro.

note.en: Ser Failures is a human warrior with a strong complexion. He is blond, with braided hair and beard, pale skin, and deep blue eyes. He wears steel chainmail under a heavily worn tabard that used to be blue, with what would seem like a heraldic gryphon drawn over it. He carries both a longsword and a shortsword and often uses them together when fighting. Ser Failures tends to study an old book that is filled with his notes. He has a cheerful and somewhat lax personality, something rarely found inside the Maze. Although many of his acquaintances consider him a doofus, he has something that sets him apart from other Raiders: he remembers. He keeps some memories about a mission in his previous life, because he is in fact, a devotee of the Goddess of Magic. His proof is a scarred tattoo of her symbol engraved on his chest.
note.es: Guerrero humano rubio con tabardo gastado y un libro lleno de notas. Es alegre y conserva recuerdos de una misión anterior al Laberinto. El Amo decide su participación en el encuentro.

note.en: He is a young, weathered shadow of a man vested in threadbare robes. His patchy, shaved head and messy goatee frame the face of a mad- man. Faded tattoos scattered over his jaundiced skin betray a criminal past. His bloodshot eyes dart nervously over the place, compulsively scratching his arms and face. When he speaks, his drained voice trig- gers feelings of danger and pity. Spell-Eater is a pathetic little man. He paces furtively, searching desperately for something, and carries any conversation in a cynical, sarcastic tone. His only joy seems to come from belittling any person compassionate enough to engage him.
note.es: Hombre joven de aspecto consumido, ropas raídas y tatuajes desvaídos. Se mueve nerviosamente y conversa con cinismo y sarcasmo. El Amo decide su participación en el encuentro.
